```yaml
name: Claude Workflow

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - devin/1750235416-qa-agent-generateddl
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - devin/1750235416-qa-agent-generateddl

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npx eslint .

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Test project
        run: npm test
```
